Title: Heroes of the Storm Live Patch Notes - September 30, 2025
Subtitle: [Heroes of the Storm Live Patch Notes - September 30, 2025] Our next Heroes of the Storm patch is live! Read on for more information. View Full Article
Highlights: [Heroes of the Storm Live Patch Notes - September 30, 2025] Our next Heroes of the Storm patch is live! Read on for more information. View Full Article
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  Experience:
  • Small Experience Globes ~~will now vanish if no allied Hero is within 15 radius of them~~ have been removed .
  A Call for Help:
  • Forts, Keeps, and Core will now grant allied Heroes that take damage in their radius ~~50~~ 35 Armor for 4 seconds.
    • [Undocumented] Forts grant this Armor to allied Heroes within 5.4 range from their center.
    • [Undocumented] Keeps grant this Armor to allied Heroes within 6.8 range from their center.
    • [Undocumented] Core grants this Armor to allied Heroes within 8.2 range from their center.
  • ~~While this Armor is in effect, enemy Heroes that attack the target will be Slowed by 20%.~~
  • Forts, Keeps, and Core will no longer prioritize an enemy Hero when an allied Hero is attacked.
  Minions:
  • When a Hero attacks an enemy Structure with a Basic Attack, allied Minions nearby become Inspired, gaining 35% Attack Speed and 35% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.
  Structures:
  • Fort's Gates
    • Health increased by 12.5% [Undocumented] , from 5300 to 6000 .
  • Keep's Gates
    • Health increased by 12.5% [Undocumented] , from 6150 to 7000 .
  • Fort's Towers
    • Health increased by 12.5% [Undocumented] , from 4300 to 4850 .
  • Keep's Towers
    • Health increased by 12.5% [Undocumented] , from 5300 to 6000 .
  • Forts
    • Health increased by 12.5% [Undocumented] , from 15450 to 17380 .
  • Keeps
    • Health increased by 12.5% [Undocumented] , from 20050 to 22550 .
  Gameplay:
  • Basic Attacks that cleave and splash will now function more consistently across all Heroes through various situations.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue causing Minions to have their spawn increasingly delayed during the game.
